brief:
Israeli settlers attacked two Palestinian homes in Yatta, south of Hebron, on Saturday evening, damaging property and attempting to break into one of the houses, according to Wafa. The attackers targeted residences in the town, which lies in the southern West Bank.

No casualty figures were reported in connection with the assault. The incident is among ongoing tensions between Israeli settlers and Palestinian residents in the occupied West Bank.

title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinian homes in Yatta south of Hebron
